experiment: P3o-E state-preserving frozen frequency delay parameter residual
frozen_method: Train the F local time-frequency base with BCEWithLogits plus 0.1 masked SmoothL1 and select C_joint using early identities only. Then freeze its parameters and force every base submodule into eval inside the side branch train method. Optimize only the posterior-conditioned delay residual. Reuse the F calibration threshold exactly; do not select from development.
mandatory_predata_unit_invariant: After side.train() and one optimizer step, every F parameter and named buffer are bitwise unchanged, all F submodules remain eval, and F logits equal the base logits bitwise.
prohibition: No modification of data generator, code, widths, losses, residual scale, checkpoint rule, threshold, promotion gate, or optimizer after the development output directory is created. Do not generate/open test or locked test; do not use P3o-D reserved confirmation identities.
